name: @activepieces/piece-wayfront
description: Unify your process, automate steps, and help clients find what they need.

auth.description: Provide your Wayfront workspace URL and bearer token.

create_client.name: create_client
create_client.description: Creates a new client in your Wayfront workspace.

email.description: The email address of the client.

status_id.description: Numeric ID of the client status. Find status IDs in your Wayfront workspace settings.

referrer_user_id.description: ID of the team member who referred this client.

balance.description: Starting account balance for the client.

optin.description: Opt-in status for the client, e.g. "Yes" or "No".

stripe_id.description: The Stripe customer ID to link to this client.

created_at.description: Override the creation date. Format: 2021-09-01T00:00:00+00:00. Leave empty to use the current date.

address_country.description: Two-letter country code, e.g. US or GB.

custom_fields.description: Additional custom fields as key-value pairs.

aiMetadata.description: Creates a new client record in a Wayfront workspace from contact details (name, email, company, phone, address, status, balance, custom fields). Use to onboard a customer or lead into the CRM. All fields are optional, so passing none creates an empty client. Not idempotent: each call adds a separate client even with identical input.

update_client.name: update_client
update_client.description: Updates a client in your Wayfront workspace. Only provided fields are changed.

user_id.description: Select a client from your Wayfront workspace.

status_id.description: Numeric ID of the client status. Find status IDs in your Wayfront workspace settings.

referrer_user_id.description: ID of the team member who referred this client.

employee_id.description: Comma-separated IDs of employees to assign to this client (e.g. 1,2,3).

balance.description: Updated account balance for the client.

stripe_id.description: The Stripe customer ID linked to this client.

address_country.description: Two-letter country code, e.g. US or GB.

custom_fields.description: Additional custom fields as key-value pairs.

aiMetadata.description: Updates an existing Wayfront client identified by its user ID, applying a partial patch — only the fields you supply (contact details, status, balance, assigned employees, address, custom fields) are changed; omitted fields are left untouched. Use to edit a known client; requires a valid user ID. Idempotent: re-sending the same patch leaves the client in the same state.

create_activity.name: create_activity
create_activity.description: Creates a new activity log entry for a client in Wayfront.

user_id.description: Select a client from your Wayfront workspace.

content.description: The activity note or description (max 10,000 characters).

scheduled_at.description: Schedule this activity for a future date and time. Format: 2026-04-15T14:00:00Z (ISO 8601). Leave empty to log it immediately.

assigned_to.description: Select a team member to assign this activity to.

aiMetadata.description: Logs a new activity (note) against a specific Wayfront client, optionally scheduling it for a future date and assigning it to a team member. With no scheduled date it is logged immediately. Use to record an interaction or queue a follow-up; requires the client user ID and content. Not idempotent: each call appends a separate activity.

update_activity.name: update_activity
update_activity.description: Updates an existing activity for a client in Wayfront.

user_id.description: Select a client from your Wayfront workspace.

activity_id.description: Select an activity for the chosen client.

content.description: The updated activity note or description (max 10,000 characters).

scheduled_at.description: Reschedule the activity. Format: 2026-05-01T14:00:00Z (ISO 8601). Only applies to already-scheduled activities.

assigned_to.description: Select a team member to assign this activity to.

aiMetadata.description: Updates an existing activity on a Wayfront client, changing its content and optionally its assignee or scheduled date (rescheduling only applies to already-scheduled activities). Use to edit a known activity; requires both the client user ID and the activity ID. Idempotent: re-sending the same values yields the same activity state.

complete_activity.name: complete_activity
complete_activity.description: Marks a scheduled activity as complete for a client in Wayfront.

user_id.description: Select a client from your Wayfront workspace.

activity_id.description: Select an activity for the chosen client.

aiMetadata.description: Marks a specific scheduled activity on a Wayfront client as complete. Use to close out a follow-up or task once done; requires both the client user ID and the activity ID. Idempotent: completing an already-completed activity leaves it complete with no additional effect.

create_ticket.name: create_ticket
create_ticket.description: Creates a new support ticket for a client in Wayfront.

user_id.description: Select a client from your Wayfront workspace.

subject.description: The subject line of the ticket.

note.description: An internal note to attach to the ticket.

status.description: Numeric ID of the ticket status. Find status IDs in your Wayfront workspace settings.

employees.description: Comma-separated IDs of employees to assign to this ticket (e.g. 1,2,3).

tags.description: Comma-separated list of tags to apply to the ticket (e.g. billing,urgent).

order.description: The order number or reference to link to this ticket.

metadata.description: Comma-separated metadata values to attach to the ticket.

aiMetadata.description: Creates a new support ticket for a specific Wayfront client, with a subject and optional note, status, assigned employees, tags, linked order reference, and metadata. Use to open a support case from an inbound request. Requires the client user ID and a subject. Not idempotent: each call opens a separate ticket.

list_tickets.name: list_tickets
list_tickets.description: Returns a list of tickets from your Wayfront workspace, sorted by most recent first.

limit.description: Maximum number of tickets to return per page. Defaults to 20.

page.description: Page number to retrieve when results span multiple pages. Starts at 1.

aiMetadata.description: Retrieves a page of support tickets from the Wayfront workspace, newest first, with configurable page size and page number for pagination. Use to browse, scan, or look up recent tickets. Read-only and idempotent: it returns current data without modifying anything.

update_ticket.name: update_ticket
update_ticket.description: Updates a ticket in Wayfront. Only the fields you provide will be changed.

ticket_ref.description: Select a ticket from your Wayfront workspace.

subject.description: Updated subject line for the ticket.

status.description: Numeric ID of the ticket status. Find status IDs in your Wayfront workspace settings.

employees.description: Comma-separated IDs of employees to assign to this ticket (e.g. 1,2,3).

tags.description: Comma-separated list of tags (e.g. billing,urgent). Replaces all existing tags.

order.description: The order number or reference to link to this ticket.

metadata.description: Comma-separated metadata values to attach to the ticket.

aiMetadata.description: Updates an existing Wayfront ticket identified by its reference, applying a partial patch to subject, status, assigned employees, tags, linked order, or metadata; omitted fields are left untouched, but supplying tags replaces all existing tags. Use to change a ticket’s state or routing. Idempotent: re-sending the same patch yields the same ticket state.

list_orders.name: list_orders
list_orders.description: Returns a list of orders from your Wayfront workspace, sorted by most recent first.

limit.description: Maximum number of orders to return per page. Defaults to 20.

page.description: Page number to retrieve when results span multiple pages. Starts at 1.

aiMetadata.description: Retrieves a page of orders from the Wayfront workspace, newest first, with configurable page size and page number for pagination. Use to browse, scan, or look up recent orders. Read-only and idempotent: it returns current data without modifying anything.

create_order.name: create_order
create_order.description: Creates a new order for a client in Wayfront.

user_id.description: Select a client from your Wayfront workspace.

service.description: The name of the service or title for this order (e.g. "Instagram Followers"). Required if no Service ID is provided.

service_id.description: ID of an existing service in Wayfront to attach to this order. Required if no Service / Order Title is provided.

note.description: An internal note to attach to the order.

status.description: Numeric ID of the order status. Find status IDs in your Wayfront workspace settings.

number.description: Custom order reference number (e.g. B1C2D3E4F5). Leave empty to auto-generate.

date_due.description: Due date for the order. Format: 2021-09-01T00:00:00+00:00 (ISO 8601).

date_started.description: Date the order was started. Format: 2021-09-01T00:00:00+00:00 (ISO 8601).

date_completed.description: Date the order was completed. Format: 2021-09-01T00:00:00+00:00 (ISO 8601).

created_at.description: Override the creation date. Format: 2021-09-01T00:00:00+00:00. Leave empty to use now.

employees.description: Comma-separated IDs of employees to assign to this order (e.g. 1,2,3).

tags.description: Comma-separated list of tags to apply to the order (e.g. vip,rush).

linked_orders.description: Comma-separated order numbers to link to this order (e.g. B1C2D3,E4F5G6).

metadata.description: Comma-separated metadata values to attach to the order.

aiMetadata.description: Creates a new order for a specific Wayfront client. Identify the service either by a free-text service title or by an existing service ID (supply one of the two); optionally set status, order number, due/start/completion/created dates, assigned employees, tags, linked orders, and metadata. Requires the client user ID. Not idempotent: each call creates a separate order.

update_order.name: update_order
update_order.description: Updates an order in Wayfront. Only the fields you provide will be changed.

order_ref.description: Select an order from your Wayfront workspace.

note.description: Updated internal note for the order.

status.description: Numeric ID of the order status. Find status IDs in your Wayfront workspace settings.

service_id.description: ID of the service to attach to this order.

employees.description: Comma-separated IDs of employees to assign to this order (e.g. 1,2,3).

tags.description: Comma-separated list of tags (e.g. vip,rush). Replaces all existing tags.

linked_orders.description: Comma-separated order numbers to link (e.g. B1C2D3,E4F5G6). Replaces existing links.

form_data.description: Comma-separated form data values to attach to the order.

metadata.description: Comma-separated metadata values to attach to the order.

aiMetadata.description: Updates an existing Wayfront order identified by its reference, applying a partial patch to note, status, service, dates, assigned employees, tags, linked orders, form data, or metadata; omitted fields are left untouched, but supplying tags or linked orders replaces the existing set. Use to advance or amend a known order. Idempotent: re-sending the same patch yields the same order state.
